purpose: Fresh no-AI fusion, filter, and effort traces. Learner answers are not stored.

rrf_example.note: Fuse these two ranked lists with RRF, k=60. Do not add the raw scores. Show each 1/(60+rank) term.

raw_scores_trap.note: Adding cosine and BM25 silently lets the trap outrank the gold. Ranks, not raw scores, are comparable.

late_filter_example.note: Filtering only after a small top-k can drop every eligible relevant id. Pre-filter the eligible set first.

effort_example.note: Low search effort can miss exact neighbors even when embeddings are identical.

when_exact_is_enough.note: State when a simple exact in-memory index is still preferable to an approximate store.

query_choice.semantic: What should a user do if they forgot their password?
query_choice.note: Choose dense, sparse, or hybrid for each. Do not reuse notebook traces.

rrf_oracle.note: Fixture properties for tests, not learner evidence.
